question: Where is museum positioned within 70 kilometers when moving from Anvil Arts Studio, Newland, NC toward North Carolina Arboretum, Asheville, NC?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_city, addr_state FROM pois WHERE tourism = 'museum' AND ST_Intersects( pois.geometry::geography, ST_Buffer( ST_MakeLine( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Anvil Arts Studio%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Newland%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NC%' LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%North Carolina Arboretum%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Asheville%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NC%' LIMIT 1 ) )::geography, 70000 ) );
